claim_boundary: V9 produced no benchmark result and cannot be described as PASS, FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE model evidence. It reserved no attempt, called no model, and created no canonical archive. This record preserves an unexecutable preregistered host matrix and prevents any later call from being counted under v9. It does not change v8, and it is not itself evidence about the product.

measured_state.note: No packet was ever built or frozen under v9, so there is nothing to measure. Unlike the v6 record, which preserves the measurements of an invalid representation, this record preserves the absence of any measurement.

reason: The v9 protocol fixes a Codex-only host matrix and its runner pins the local Codex CLI, so the phase can only be executed on that one host. That host is no longer available to this operator, so the preregistered matrix can never be run as written, and amending a pinned protocol after the fact would destroy the value of preregistering it. V9 is therefore recorded as superseded before freeze rather than amended, exactly as v6 was.
